name: Yasya Smaranamatrena
text:
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण जन्मसंसारबन्धनात् ।
विमुच्यते नमस्तस्मै विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे ॥
meaning: By simply remembering Vishnu one is freed from the bonds of birth and worldly life. I bow to the all-powerful Vishnu.
purpose: An opening verse of the Vishnu Sahasranama.
when: At the opening of a Vishnu practice.
